evidence_items.summary: CMI-Bench tutorial test audio This ISMIR tutorial bundle contains two GiantSteps key-detection clips and two Ballroom beat-tracking clips from the official CMI-Bench test audio release. The archive preserves the original CMI-Bench file paths for the selected clips. It includes a companion notebook for using the official evaluator. The test clips are provided for noncommercial research and teaching under the terms of the upstream release and its source datasets.
